matchStrings: # renovate: datasource=(?<datasource>[a-z0-9.-]+?) depName=(?<depName>[^\s]+?)(?: packageName=(?<packageName>[^\s]+?))?(?: versioning=(?<versioning>[^\s]+?))?(?: extractVersion=(?<extractVersion>[^\s]+?))?(?: registryUrl=(?<registryUrl>[^\s]+?))?[ \t]*\r?\n[ \t]*(?:ENV +|ARG +|export +)?[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+\s*(?::=|[:=])\s*["']?(?<currentValue>[^\s"']+)["']?
